chunks: When they had cast, Moses said: 'What you have cast is the magic; surely Allah will nullify it; surely Allah does not make righteous the work of the corrupters.'
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Moses say about the magicians' spells in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this declaration underscores the ontological superiority of divine truth (haqq) over ephemeral illusion (batil), affirming that Allah's validation of the prophets' signs renders human artifice null. The term 'mufsidin' is often interpreted not merely as the magicians but as those who distort reality to serve tyrannical power, a concept central to the struggle between Imam Ali (AS) and the Umayyads. This moment prefigures the ultimate victory of the Ahl al-Bayt, where divine decree permanently invalidates the claims of oppressors.
